name: 653. A forwarded body that gives a member twice is refused 400 before any plugin reads it (repeated body member refused)
description: TXE-7994. A body forwarded to the provider as written (a passthrough body, or a raw request body) was read by Bifrost's gates with gjson, which keeps the first of two equal keys, while encoding/json, sonic and the vendor keep the last. A virtual key restricted to model A could send {"model":"A","model":"B"}: governance checked A and the provider ran B. Core now refuses, with 400 caller_invalid_request naming the member's path and before any plugin runs (PluginPipeline.RunLLMPreHooks): a JSON key given twice in one object at any depth (model also when only its case differs, in the root object or an object of a root array), a JSON body that does not parse strictly (a declared JSON Lines file is read line by line), a JSON body that nests past 512 levels, and a multipart name given twice when any of its parts is a text field (read by the declared boundary; a multipart body that does not parse is refused). The rows use the native Anthropic Messages passthrough to DeepSeek's Anthropic endpoint on tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs (providerErrorFixture=1, the gateway of provider-error-fixture.config.json, as folder 311). Rows 1 and 2 are red on a gateway without the fix: the body is forwarded and answered 200. Row 3 is the control: the same body naming each member once is still forwarded. TXE-8012: the declared Content-Type decides how a body is read, never its first byte. Row 4 uploads a text/plain body opening with "{" to /v1/files: an upload route, so it is forwarded as a file. Row 5 sends the same body declared application/json to chat: the router refuses it 400 as JSON that is not valid. Row 6 sends strict JSON naming a model as text/plain to chat: refused 400, since no gate reads a text/plain body as JSON. Row 7 sends row 4's body as text/plain to chat: outside upload routes a body that opens like JSON must be strict JSON, so it is refused 400. Rows 4, 6 and 7 are red on a gateway without TXE-8012.
